notes: Native DeepSeek OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions API rates for DeepSeek V4. The official pricing table lists cache-hit input, cache-miss input, and output prices per 1M tokens. Reasoning content is returned as completion-token detail and is billed within the output token bucket; server-side tool calls and gateways are outside this token-price estimate.

deepseek-v4-pro.notes: Current DeepSeek V4 Pro native model. 1M-token context, thinking mode supported and enabled by default, max output documented as 384K.

deepseek-v4-flash.notes: Current DeepSeek V4 Flash native model. 1M-token context, thinking and non-thinking modes supported.
